description: Runs the free RenterCheck on one home to rent in England, as on rentercheck.co.uk: energy certificate, flood and planning designations, recorded crime nearby and sale history. Returns the findings, a link to the free report, and a link to Complete RenterCheck for the same home (rent comparison, owner, costs, deposit limits, tenancy agreement check). Give the postcode with either an address_id from find_addresses or the house number or name; if more than one home matches it returns the choices to ask about. Include the monthly rent if the renter knows it.

address.description: The flat or house number or name, and street, e.g. "Flat 3, 12 Hyde Park Road".

bedrooms.description: Optional: number of bedrooms, 0 for a studio.

monthly_rent_pounds.description: Optional: the monthly rent asked, in pounds.

postcode.description: A full postcode in England, such as "LS6 1AA".

name: run_free_check
title: Run a free RenterCheck
